faq.descripcion: Everything you need to know before kicking off our next development engagement.

q1.pregunta: What technologies do you use for Full Stack development?
q1.respuesta: I specialize in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, EF Core, Dapper) for robust, high-performance backend architectures, paired with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend for modern, lightning-fast, SEO-optimized user interfaces.

q2.pregunta: What does the workflow and communication look like during the project?
q2.respuesta: I operate under agile methodologies with well-defined sprints. We maintain regular progress meetings, functional demos in staging environments, and direct access to a code repository or board so you have total visibility at every stage.

q3.pregunta: How long does it typically take to develop an application or system?
q3.respuesta: It depends on complexity and scope. A modern website or optimized landing page is typically delivered in 1 to 2 weeks, while an MVP or custom enterprise management system (.NET + Next.js) is usually structured in bi-weekly sprints over 4 to 10 weeks with continuous delivery.

q4.pregunta: Does the delivered software adhere to best practices and automated testing?
q4.respuesta: Absolutely. All code follows SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, and strict separation of concerns (Repository, Service, Controller). I include tests for critical business logic and clear technical documentation to ensure effortless maintainability.

q5.pregunta: Do you handle server setup, domain configuration, and production deployment?
q5.respuesta: Yes, I deliver turnkey solutions. I configure the entire infrastructure: domain linking, SSL certificates (HTTPS), production databases (PostgreSQL/SQL Server), and automated CI/CD cloud deployment pipelines (Vercel, Azure, VPS, or Docker containers).

q6.pregunta: Do you work on existing legacy systems or only greenfield projects?
q6.respuesta: I can both build new projects from scratch and integrate with existing systems. I conduct code audits, database query optimizations, legacy code refactoring, and modernize monoliths into modern REST APIs.

q7.pregunta: What happens after delivery? Do you provide warranty or ongoing support?
q7.respuesta: Every project includes a post-launch warranty period (15 to 30 days) to address any adjustments or fixes at zero extra cost. Additionally, I provide monthly retainer maintenance plans and ongoing feature development to support your business as it scales.

q8.pregunta: Will I own full rights to the source code and infrastructure credentials?
q8.respuesta: 100% of the intellectual property, source code repositories (GitHub/GitLab), server credentials, and deployment environments belong exclusively to you or your company upon completion.

q9.pregunta: What hiring and collaboration models do you offer?
q9.respuesta: I offer both fixed-price projects (with clearly defined scope, deliverables, and milestones from day one) and hourly or sprint-based contracts for ongoing development and high-level architectural consulting.

q10.pregunta: How are invoicing and payments coordinated?
q10.respuesta: I operate with transparent payment milestones (typically 50% upfront and 50% upon approved delivery, or per bi-weekly sprint). I provide tax invoices and accept local bank transfers as well as international payment methods for global clients.
